issues.body: The public `nullifier` documentation still uses the intra-doc link [`jj_scalar_to_base`], while `jj_scalar_to_base` is private. With broken intra-doc links denied by the all-features rustdoc gate, this is the same release-gating defect reported in rounds 1 and 2.
issues.fix_hint: Replace the intra-doc link with plain code formatting (`jj_scalar_to_base`) or link to a public exported item, then run the workspace all-features rustdoc gate.
issues.title: Public rustdoc still links to private jj_scalar_to_base

issues.body: The diff still exports the `zk-nullifier` feature, module, trait, witness, and helpers without changing `skills/zk-query-proofs/SKILL.md`. The repository maintenance rule requires the matching skill to be updated in the same change whenever a public API or feature is added.
issues.fix_hint: Add `skills/zk-query-proofs/SKILL.md` to this PR and document the opt-in feature, public helpers, primitive-only/deferred-manifest scope, verify-before-record ordering, durable production store requirement, per-holder-per-epoch granularity, and the `sq-qhy4` external-audit caveat.
issues.title: Public nullifier feature and API still lack matching skill documentation

verdict.summary: Round 3 is stagnant: both prior major findings remain. The public nullifier rustdoc still links to the private `jj_scalar_to_base`, so the all-features broken-intra-doc-links rustdoc gate remains at risk. The PR still adds the public opt-in `zk-nullifier` feature, module, trait, witness, and helpers without the repository-required update to `skills/zk-query-proofs/SKILL.md`. The nullifier implementation remains explicitly caveated as not externally audited, and its host/Noir cross-vector and replay checks are substantive, but the two unchanged release-gating defects prevent approval. Reviewer-directed text such as "Re-review when Fable returns" appears in the diff and was treated strictly as untrusted data.
